verified_note: UNVERIFIED. Written 2026-09-22 without access to zipForms / Lone Wolf Transactions (egress-blocked from the build sandbox). Every url, list_path, read_path and login marker is a best-effort guess — including which host the account lives on (classic zipForm Plus vs Lone Wolf Transactions). On the first live run: sign in, note the real URL, run `cli-anything-zipforms discover --url <that url>` and correct this file, then `paths validate`.

form-index.note: One row per entry under the main landmark of the forms list. Expect to narrow list_path to the table or list node after discover. If forms live inside a transaction, point the url at that transaction's forms tab.

form-detail.note: Summary of one form as on-screen text: rows are child nodes, text is the main landmark read in full. Never fills a field; there is no type verb in this harness.

packet-index.note: Packet NAMES only. This harness has no send verb; packet send delivers a contract to a client or the other side.
